paragraphs.text: Fanning out from the coasts of Zhalfir and the Buleusi Bay on Dominaria were the Chaza Isles . They enjoyed a tropical but slightly temperate climate from their position on the shallow, glowing Jaema Sea .

These small islands hid a remote atoll known as Teferi’s Isle . This is where the planeswalker Teferi retreated to perform his experiments on the manipulation of time. When these experiments went haywire, the Phasing of Teferi's Isle , causing everything on Teferi's Isle - plants, beasts, buildings, and Teferi himself - to become temporarily removed from the time stream . This attracted the mages Jolrael , Mangara , and Kaervek , thus indirectly causing the Mirage Wars .

Teferi phased Zhalfir out , and the Chaza Isles and parts of northwestern Jamuraa with it during the Phyrexian Invasion . They were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.
The phased-out portion of the Isles was returned to the multiverse during the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch after the New Phyrexian Invasion . They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
